D: Over 12 years, two friends argue whether men and women can ever just be friends.
P: Serve mains when they get to Katz's Deli.
S: Fried deli pickles with mustard mayo
the famous deli scene, pickles on every table

Half-sour pickle spears in a crisp rye-flour batter, fried hot and served with a sharp deli mustard mayo. Cut 4 half-sour or dill pickles into spears and pat very dry. Whisk 80g plain flour, 40g rye flour, half a tsp paprika and 150ml cold soda water into a batter. Dip the spears and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp, then drain. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp yellow mustard and 1 tsp pickle brine for the dip.
Mash potato with onion fried slowly in butter, salt and white pepper, wrap in puff pastry, egg wash, bake at 200C for 25 minutes, hot mustard.
Harry spitting grape seeds out the car window on the drive to New York

Grapes roasted with thyme and balsamic until jammy, piled on whipped ricotta toasts with honey and black pepper. Toss 400g red grapes with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp balsamic and 4 thyme sprigs and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until blistered. Slice 1 baguette into 16 rounds, brush with oil and bake 8 minutes until crisp. Whip 250g ricotta with 1 tbsp honey, lemon zest and salt. Spread on the toasts, top with the grapes and finish with honey and cracked pepper.
M: Steam sliced pastrami 10 minutes until glossy and soft, pile high on seeded rye with yellow mustard, a full sour on the side.
dressing on the side, everything on the side
Ham, turkey, Swiss, egg, tomato and cucumber on iceberg, with every element in its own little bowl.
W: Apple pie à la mode, her way
heated, ice cream on the side, strawberry if you have it
Apple pie warmed at 180C for 10 minutes, strawberry ice cream on the side, whipped cream if you don't.
K: Chocolate syrup in a tall glass, 100ml cold milk, then soda water blasted in hard and stirred to a foam head. No egg, no cream.

Mix into the mash with salt and white pepper, then cool.
Cut each pastry sheet into four squares and divide the filling among them. Fold and seal into parcels.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C until golden.
Serve two small knish each with hot mustard.

Slice the baguette into 16 rounds, brush with oil and bake until crisp.
Whip the ricotta with some of the honey, lemon zest and salt.
Spread on the toasts, top with grapes and finish with honey and pepper.

Spread the rye with mustard.
Pile the pastrami high on four slices and close the sandwiches.
Serve each with a pickle on the side.

s.note: Buttery potato and slow fried onion wrapped in golden puff pastry.
s.how: Peel and chop 400g potatoes, boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain and mash. Slowly fry 1 finely diced brown onion in 30g butter over medium-low heat for 15 minutes until golden. Mix into the mash with 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp white pepper. Cool. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into four squares each. Divide the filling among them, fold and seal into parcels. Brush with 1 beaten egg. Bake at 200°C conventional for 25 minutes until golden. Serve two small knish each with 40g hot English mustard.

s.note: Grapes roasted with thyme and balsamic until jammy, piled on whipped ricotta toasts with honey and black pepper.
s.how: Toss 400g red grapes with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp balsamic and 4 thyme sprigs and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until blistered. Slice 1 baguette into 16 rounds, brush with oil and bake 8 minutes until crisp. Whip 250g ricotta with 1 tbsp honey, lemon zest and salt. Spread on the toasts, top with the grapes and finish with honey and cracked pepper.

m.note: Steamed pastrami piled on seeded rye with mustard and sour pickles.
m.how: Place 600g sliced pastrami in a steamer over gently boiling water and steam for 10 minutes until glossy, soft and piping hot. Spread 8 slices seeded rye bread with 40g yellow mustard. Divide the pastrami between four slices, pile high and close the sandwiches. Serve each with 1 full sour dill pickle on the side.

w.n: Apple pie à la mode, her way
w.note: Warm apple pie with strawberry ice cream served on the side.
w.how: Cut four slices from a 600g ready-baked apple pie. Warm on a tray at 180°C conventional for 10 minutes. Serve 75ml strawberry ice cream in a separate small bowl beside each slice. If strawberry ice cream is unavailable, softly whip 150ml thickened cream and serve it on the side instead.

d.note: Chocolate syrup, cold milk and soda water stirred to a foamy head.
d.how: Put 25ml chocolate syrup in each of four tall glasses. Pour 100ml very cold full cream milk into each. Add 150ml chilled soda water quickly and stir briskly to form a foamy head. Serve immediately. This drink contains no egg or cream.
